title: MT4 Expert Advisor Scams (ForexPeaceArmy Educational Guide)

scam_and_failure_patterns.name: Exponential Lot-Doubling Martingale Masked in Backtests
scam_and_failure_patterns.evidence: 12-year 99% modeling quality backtest showed deceptive 31.11% equity drawdown graph while true Relative Drawdown hit 93.02%, trading only 111 trades and escalating lot sizes to unfillable 200-1000 lots.
scam_and_failure_patterns.detection_rule: Inspect Relative Drawdown % vs Max DD %, trade count, and sequential lot escalation (lot_k+1 > lot_k after loss).

scam_and_failure_patterns.name: Holding Losing Trades Indefinitely (Equity vs Closed Balance Illusion)
scam_and_failure_patterns.evidence: Observed losing positions held open 277 to 1,287 days (~3.5 years) to avoid booking realized losses, creating rising balance curves alongside severe floating equity drawdowns.
scam_and_failure_patterns.detection_rule: Audit max trade duration, unrealized MAE, and floating equity-to-balance divergence.

scam_and_failure_patterns.name: Ultra-Fast 0-3 Second Latency/Delayed-Feed Scalpers
scam_and_failure_patterns.evidence: Scammers showcase historical 0-3 second trades exploiting unmodeled demo feed delays or tight fixed backtest spreads that collapse under live broker spreads, slippage, and anti-arbitrage delays.
scam_and_failure_patterns.detection_rule: Flag <5s median hold duration and test sensitivity to +0.5/+1.0/+2.0 pip spread and 100-500ms latency.

scam_and_failure_patterns.name: Missing Stop-Loss (No Hard SL Wipeout Trap)
scam_and_failure_patterns.evidence: EAs operating with StopLoss = 0 harvest high win rates in mean-reverting regimes until a single sustained trend wipes out the entire account.
scam_and_failure_patterns.detection_rule: Verify hard SL > 0 on every entry deal (OrderSend/CTrade) or enforce external equity-governor kill switch.

conflict_of_interest_note: Article concludes by promoting Equity Sentry EA (author product); empirical failure modes above remain independently corroborated by Alina Lab EXP/MBL-001.
